limits: All nine series are development data; state prediction is not tactical truth.
Same raw effective inputs and optimizer-step budget, not equal FLOPs or parameter count; exact 120 permutations cost more compute.
No hyperparameter/architecture search, no added seeds after outcomes.
RAM >=2 GiB at startup and >=1.5 GiB during fitting; CUDA allocation cap 20%; single process.
No new Demos, human labels, AI silver, map IDs, teams or outcomes in inputs.
All stored v7 comparisons retained; no product-model replacement.

training.loss: snapshot reconstruction + next-state masked MSE; equal weight
training.checkpoint: lowest validation next-state MSE; target tests not used
training.selection: training-only normalization; ridge penalty chosen only on fold validation; no target-driven routing; preserve every seed
training.neural_scoring: same death-floor/order projection as ridge, at validation selection and test; training residual model unchanged
training.prefix_ridge: first 1/2/3/4 available 10D observations, zero future padding, four-way time index; 44 inputs, normalization fit on train only
training.velocity: current plus observed latest change times next_dt/last_dt, persistence at first horizon; project constraints
training.G5: initialize from selected G4 weight, train on G4 source plus first target-map support series; same source validation; no target validation
training.G5_control: initialize from identical G4 weight, continue on source only, cycle batches to exactly match optimizer steps each epoch; same validation selection rule
training.source_dataset: only nine directly parsed series; upstream samples excluded from retraining because source series identity unknown

targeted_tests.scope: Two model invariance/causality checks plus two geometry/mask checks; no full suite rerun
targeted_tests.gpu_test_runner: Isolated GPU Python, appending existing base site-packages only to load installed pytest; no package installation

ordinary_regression_environment.reason: PyTorch intentionally absent from ordinary requirements; GPU environment ran all four tests.

complete_dataset_check.timepoint: post-training full file check; also checked during geometry audit
complete_dataset_check.repeat_rule: Run the full geometry audit before and after any repeat training; run script report/target checks alone do not cover all raw node fields.
